Lad Who Is Always Being Reminded To Send Money He Owes On Revolut Loving All This

BREAKING NEWS, Featured-One
By Julius Hubris
October 20, 2026
3
0
Share:
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:57
Instaread

A LOCAL MAN who is currently in arrears with family, friends, coworkers and neighbours for small sums of money he pledged to ‘send straight away on Revolut’ is reportedly wearing a shit-eating grin seven kilometres wide, WWN understands.

“Ah class, this’ll buy me another 8 months of dodging people I’d say,” said local man James Concribben, of the widely reported Revolut outage which is affecting payments and services.

“Serves them Lithuanian e-banking fuckers right for introducing that little ‘reminder’ button for payments,” confirmed Concribben, who has spent years evading repayments for everything from ‘€10 for petrol’ to ‘€39 for dinner plus tip’.

Tramore.
The T-shirt.

€24.99Shop now

Concribben explained that Revolut’s widespread adoption in the Irish market was a ‘curse’ for people like him who never honour payments of small debts but that he was still able to rely on a fatal flaw in Irish people’s psyche that means it takes a huge emotional and mental toll on them to ask for money owed and find sending a follow up reminder to be a mortifying act of money-hungry lunacy.

“Back in the day, you always had your excuses loaded and ready to go like ‘I’ll get lunch next time’, ‘I’ve not got any cash on me’ and then you ghost the fucker, never talk to them again,” Concribben said of previous tactics he used on his mother.

“But with Revolut, there was this horrible ease of use, this sinister ability to send €20 onto the neighbour who paid upfront for the lad who cuts the green in the estate. Just terrifying stuff, but now this app outage business has me back in pre-Revolut heaven,” added Concribben, one once argued with a bank clerk that a one cent coin cut in half was legal tender.

Concribben had previously entertained a stoic ‘I’m not on Revolut’ stance but one shocking incident in which he was left in a cafe paying for a friend’s scone who had to rush off to collect their kids forced his hand.

“Some fuckers are tight as a duck’s arse, you’d want to watch them,” warned Concribben.

God Declines Pope Leo’s Request For Sick Leave After Lung Surgery

BREAKING NEWS ,BUSINESS ,WORLD NEWS
Share:

WITH THE VATICAN confirming that they see no reason why Pope Leo, recovering from lung surgery to treat cancer, can’t fulfill his upcoming duties on a Papal visit to South America, WWN can confirm this decision has caused significant challenges in the Vatican HR department.

“This prick is worse than Bezos. Suppose a piss break during mass is out of the question then too?” shared one disgruntled HR manager at Heavenly Profits Inc, in a rare instance of Human Resources siding with an employee, in this case the ailing Pope.

Tramore.
The T-shirt.

€24.99Shop now

The reason for the harsh words? God’s instant rejection of a request from Pope Leo for time off in the aftermath of his recent surgery.

“That’s how it starts, an employee gets a doctor’s note and then it’s another doctor’s note. Time off for occupational therapist appointment, half day for the physio, half day for follow up with surgeon, day off to attend own funeral. Work-shy chancers the lot of them,” confirmed God in an email exchange with WWN.

“But what these ungrateful underlings forget, it’s me that gave them the illness in the first place, it’s me who didn’t answer their prayers for better health. Like a doctor’s note is going o change my mind,” added the Heaven based entity.

Further disgruntlement is abound within the Vatican after a circular email to all staff sent by God last week made it clear that he was reviewing his current policy of unlimited free time in Heaven, suggesting he is intent on making clergy work remotely from Heaven in the event of their passing.
